statement: The Air (Prevention & control of pollution) Act 1981
The cost saving exercise is an ongoing one with emphasis on savings in energy consumption and cost, and reduction of wastes.
Cost of an item of property, plant and equipment comprises its purchase price... and estimated costs of dismantling and removing the item and restoring the site on which it is located.
The cost of a self-constructed item of property, plant and equipment comprises... and estimated costs of dismantling and removing the item and restoring the site on which it is located.
